mapper.sql: n.id AS notification_id, n.type AS type, n.actor_id AS actor_id, u.username AS actor_username, u.nickname AS actor_nickname, COALESCE(u.avatar_url, '') AS actor_avatar_url, n.target_id AS target_id, n.post_id AS post_id, n.is_read AS is_read, n.create_time AS create_time
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET is_read = 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
